purpose: library: NSF's explainer of the foundations of AI — the definition of AI, computer vision (1960s edge detection to the 2009 ImageNet database of more than 3 million images across 5,000 categories), stochastic modeling from the 1930s–40s to GPS routing and speech recognition, deep learning (1980s handwritten-digit neural networks, 2010s GPUs, AlphaFold2 and the 2024 Nobel Prize in chemistry), reinforcement learning (trial-and-error with rewards and penalties; Barto and Sutton's 2024 Turing Award), and AI in education (Duolingo's 2011 launch from NSF-funded research, 1980s intelligent tutoring systems, 500 million users). Fits a compare table of AI techniques, step ordering/timeline of research milestones, and quiz cards with predict-then-reveal on the numbers.
